alex: Ran a cross-GPU perf sweep (A100 / H100 / L40S) for our fused-paged + tiled attention kernels. Seq lens: 128,512,1024,2048,4096,8192. Batches: 1,2,8,16,32. Observed a reproducible latency spike on L40S at seq=2048 (batch<=4) when prefetching is enabled — P95 jumps from ~32ms -> ~118ms. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/runs/2150004321. Anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: Thanks for the run — can you paste the perf-bot summary and which kernel got selected at seq=2048 on L40S?

alex: perf-bot summary below, kernel selected: fused_paged_tiled_v2 on L40S. A100 fell back to flash_variant_b. Command used: `./bench --model=gpt2 --gpu=l40s --seq=2048 --batch=2 --kernel-policy=auto`

chris: hmm, prefetch + small batch could trigger KV-cache eviction thrash or async memcpy bursts. Did you enable prefix caching?

alex: no prefix caching for this run (`--kv-cache=none`) — requests are short-lived. But KV spill counters in the trace do spike around the regression window.

jen: Can you run an isolation test: force `--kernel-forcing=fused_paged` and `--prefetch=off` and also capture nvprof / nsight output? That should separate kernel selection vs prefetch side-effects.

alex: Kicking off those runs now. Will post results.

perf-bot: CI run queued: bench job 2150004321 on l40s-3. Trace link: http://ci/runs/2150004321 (started)

alex: Quick update — forced fused_paged with prefetch off: latency goes back to expected (P95 ~34ms). With prefetch on: P95 ~118ms. So looks like an interaction between prefetch logic and fused_paged_tiled_v2 on L40S.

ryan: Could be a driver/async-copy scheduling issue unique to L40S kernel execution order. Can you capture `nvidia-smi topo -m`, dmesg, and an async memcpy flame? Also nvprof showing memcpy H2D spikes would help.

alex: Uploaded nvprof traces and kernel flame to s3://redwood-perf/runs/2150004321/traces.tar.gz. nvprof shows H2D memcpy bursts aligned with token windows ~512-1024.

maria: Filing this as a perf regression. Assigning chris + ryan to bisect the tiled-prefetch changes. Label: `perf/regression`.

chris: On it — I'll start a `git bisect` across the last 8 commits on `tiled-prefetch` branch and run the L40S 2048/2 job until we find the culprit.

perf-bot: Created PERF-7891: "L40S prefetch + tiled kernel latency spike at seq=2048" assigned to chris, ryan. Tracker: http://tracker/7891 :mag: 

alex: Thanks. If anyone else wants the exact bench invocation I used for reproducibility:
```
./bench \\
  --model=gpt2 \\
  --gpu=l40s \\
  --seq=2048 \\
  --batch=2 \\
  --kernel-policy=auto \\
  --kv-cache=none \\
  --prefetch=on/off \\
  --trace=nvprof \\
  --out=s3://redwood-perf/runs/2150004321
```

ryan: Perfect — I'll take the first bisect pass and try a driver workaround to validate. Please add any extra traces to the ticket. :thumbsup:
